meta.description: Track your sales, agents, stock and net profit in real time. Multi-country, multi-currency, FR/AR/EN.

hero.headline: Stop guessing your profit.
hero.sub: The CRM for COD dropshippers. Track your sales, your agents, your stock and your net profit — in real time.
hero.imageAlt: VOIDCRAFT dashboard — profit chart, month switcher, agent performance

socialProof.hosting: Hosted in the EU · GDPR compliant

agents.title: Your agents: who actually delivers?
agents.body: Without per-agent data, there's no way to know who's making you money and who's burning your stock.

profit.title: Revenue ≠ profit. Do you know which?
profit.body: Top-line up, but after ads, COGS and account fees — what's actually left?

profit.body: See your true margin per product, per month — computed after ads, COGS, account fees and bonuses.

agents.title: Agent tracking
agents.body: Confirmation rate, delivery rate, attributed profit — per agent, over any period.

products.body: Enter your ads, COGS, account fees and bonuses once. Everything recalculates everywhere.

stock.title: Stock alerts
stock.body: Know when to reorder before you stock out, per product and per market.

multi.title: Multi-country, multi-currency, FR/AR/EN
multi.body: One app for every market. Native Arabic RTL. Currency per country.

agent.title: Know who makes your team money — and who costs it.
agent.body: VOIDCRAFT is the only COD CRM that attributes profit per agent. No favoritism, no guessing — the numbers decide.
agent.imageAlt: Agent detail page with top performers, confirmation rate, attributed profit

pricing.title: One plan. Everything in.
pricing.terms: 14 days free · no card required · cancel in 1 click
pricing.contactSales: Special pricing for 5+ accounts — get in touch.

security.a: Yes. Hosted on Supabase in the European Union, encrypted at rest and in transit. Every table is protected by Row-Level Security — your data is never accessible to another user. Daily backups.

export.a: Yes, anytime. CSV export of your products, agents, months and confirmations from settings. No fee, no lock-in.

arabic.q: Is the app available in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. Full Arabic interface with native RTL layout, alongside French and English. Switch languages anytime.

vsLocal.a: We compute NET profit, not just leads. Per-agent tracking. Multi-country and multi-currency in one app. Bilingual Arabic/French from day one.

mobile.a: Yes. Built for smartphone, fast data entry from the field. No install needed — it runs in your browser.

limits.q: How many agents / products can I track?
limits.a: Unlimited. No hidden caps, no tiers. Add as many products and agents as you want.

payments.a: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe. Mobile Money (Morocco, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire) coming soon.

cancel.a: No commitment. One-click cancel in settings. You keep access until the end of the paid month, and you can export everything.

finalCta.title: Ready to see your real profit?

cookies.body: We use anonymous cookies to understand how the site is used. You can opt out anytime.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft v0.2 — legal placeholders to fill in before launch.
privacy.intro: VOIDCRAFT, operated by {{COMPANY_NAME}}, respects your privacy. This page explains what data we collect, why, who we entrust it to, and how you can control it.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.body: Email, name (optional), preferred language, and all business data you enter (products, agents, sales, costs). Nothing is collected without your knowledge.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: Your data is hosted on Supabase, in the European Union (Frankfurt), encrypted at rest and in transit. Daily backups.

subprocessors.title: Sub-processors
subprocessors.body: To operate the service we share strictly necessary data with: Supabase (database and auth, EU), Stripe (payments, US/EU, PCI-DSS compliant), Resend (transactional email, EU), Sentry (error monitoring, EU), PostHog (product analytics, US), Upstash (rate limiting, EU). No data is sold.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Your business data is kept while your account is active. On cancellation, it is permanently deleted after 90 days (grace period for reactivation). Technical logs are kept for 30 days maximum.

rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
rights.body: You can access all your data, export it to CSV, correct it or delete it anytime from your settings. To exercise your rights: {{DPO_EMAIL}}.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use essential cookies (session, language preference, theme preference) and anonymous analytics cookies (PostHog). The banner at the bottom of the page lets you opt out of analytics cookies at any time. No ad cookies, no third-party trackers.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: PostHog is used to understand product usage, in anonymized mode by default. No business data is shared with third parties.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.draft: Draft v0.2 — legal placeholders to fill in before launch.
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of VOIDCRAFT, operated by {{COMPANY_NAME}}, {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}, registered under {{COMPANY_REGISTRATION}}. By creating an account, you accept these terms.

object.title: Purpose
object.body: VOIDCRAFT is a SaaS CRM for COD dropshippers: tracking sales, agents, stock and profit.

account.title: Account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials private and for actions taken from your account. One account = one person.

subscription.title: Subscription & payment
subscription.body: The subscription is monthly or annual, charged in advance via Stripe. Prices are in euros, excluding any applicable local taxes.

trial.title: Free trial
trial.body: 14 days free, no card required. After the trial, the account is deactivated unless you subscribe.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.body: You can cancel anytime in settings. Access continues until the end of the paid period. No pro-rated refund.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: VOIDCRAFT and its logo are trademarks. You retain ownership of all data you enter.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: VOIDCRAFT is provided "as is". We do everything possible to maintain availability and data integrity but cannot guarantee zero interruption.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by French law. Any dispute will be brought before the competent courts.
